zh: 比赛前我们总是先热身十分钟。
en: We always {warm up|stretch} for ten minutes before the game.

zh: 跑完步花五分钟做做放松运动。
en: Take five minutes to {cool down|warm down|stretch|recover|rest} after your run.

zh: 他每周去健身房锻炼三次。
en: He {works out|trains|exercises} at the gym three times a week.

zh: 即使我们落后，她也从不放弃。
en: She never {gives up|quits} even when we're losing.

zh: 我停下来系鞋带，只好冲刺去追上其他人。
en: I stopped to tie my lace and had to sprint to {catch up with|catch up to|catch|reach} the others.

zh: 想玩的话随时加入。
en: Feel free to {join in|join|play|join us|come along} if you want a game.

zh: 我们在半决赛被淘汰了。
en: We got {knocked out|beaten|eliminated} in the semi-final.

zh: 比赛七点半开球。
en: The match {kicks off|starts|begins} at half past seven.

zh: 我儿子正在参加校足球队的选拔。
en: My son is {trying out for|trialling for|trialing for} the school football team.

zh: 受伤之后我正在慢慢把体能练上来。
en: I'm slowly {building up|building|improving|rebuilding|working on|regaining} my fitness after the injury.

zh: 我们去伊甸公园给黑帽队加油。
en: We went to {cheer on|support|watch|see} the Black Caps at Eden Park.

zh: 因为太热，两名选手退出了比赛。
en: Two runners {dropped out of|pulled out of|withdrew from|quit} the race because of the heat.

zh: 他因为危险的铲球被罚下场。
en: He was {sent off|red-carded} for a dangerous tackle.

zh: 去年夏天我开始打网球了。
en: I {took up|started} tennis last summer.

zh: 跑完山路后我彻底累垮了。
en: I was completely {worn out|exhausted|knackered|shattered|wiped out|tired out|stuffed} after the hill run.

zh: 慢点！我跟不上你。
en: Slow down! I can't {keep up with|catch|follow} you.

zh: 我在湿草地上摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
en: I {fell over|slipped over|fell|slipped|fell down|tripped} on the wet grass and hurt my knee.

zh: 他们爆冷战胜了排名第一的球队。
en: They {pulled off|managed|got|scored|had} a surprise win against the top team.

zh: 锦标赛之前我们需要加强训练。
en: We need to {step up|increase|ramp up|lift|pick up|improve} our training before the tournament.

zh: 我们顶住了压力，最后以一分险胜。
en: We {held on|hung on|managed} to win by one point.
